entities.name: Amédée Domenech
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amédée Domenech was a French rugby union prop nicknamed Le Duc who played for RC Vichy between 1954 and 1955. After one year, he moved to CA Brive and helped the club to gain promotion to the first division. He earned his first cap with the French national team on 27 March 1954 against Wales at Cardiff. The Stade Amédée-Domenech in Brive-la-Gaillarde was named in his honour.

entities.name: Amédée Domenech
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amédée Domenech was a French rugby union prop nicknamed Le Duc who played for RC Vichy between 1954 and 1955. After one year, he moved to CA Brive and helped the club to gain promotion to the first division. He earned his first cap with the French national team on 27 March 1954 against Wales at Cardiff. The Stade Amédée-Domenech in Brive-la-Gaillarde was named in his honour.
